user.title: Electrolux / AEG (OCP Developer API)
user.description: Create an API key and generate an Access Token and Refresh Token at https://developer.electrolux.one/dashboard, then paste all three values here. Keep these credentials secret.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Electrolux / AEG
reauth_confirm.description: Your tokens are no longer valid. Generate fresh tokens at https://developer.electrolux.one/dashboard and paste them here.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the API key and tokens.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Electrolux API.

abort.wrong_account: These credentials belong to a different Electrolux account than the one being re-authenticated. Use tokens from the same account.

init.title: Options
init.description: The Electrolux Developer API is rate-limited. Intervals below 120 seconds may cause errors.
